description:
SCC/round-settledness-gated re-analysis: collapse cross-round AnalyzeActivation churn.

RIDE-ALONG DONE (d0542a511): return_type.defined telemetry now carries changed:bool. MAIN FIX = its own dedicated arc (design complete + push/pull-verified 2026-07-03; NOT a point-fix).

ROOT CAUSE (precisely located): prepare_function_call (semantic.rs:1562) does reads.push(FactKey::ReturnType(callee_activation)) — an ordinary per-callee scheduler subscription. coalesced_seen (scheduler.rs:180,249) only dedupes wakes WITHIN one complete() batch, not across sequential callee completions across rounds. That is the cross-round batching gap: N callees settling on N rounds = N full re-analyses of the caller, most byte-identical (changed=false).

CRITICAL CONSTRAINT (why the naive design deadlocks): semantic.rs:78-83 documents that callers deliberately only READ (never WAIT ON) callee ReturnType, so mutual recursion cannot deadlock. Therefore a naive 'coarse cone-settled fact the caller WAITS on' CAN NEVER SETTLE for a real recursive SCC (circular wait). The fix must NOT be a coarse-fact-wait.

PUSH/PULL VERDICT for direction (a) — SCC cone-settle: PULL, but ONLY if built as a CONE-INTERNAL PRODUCER. The forbidden shape ('on cone-settle, enqueue/schedule the caller' — a settle handler pushing the caller) is avoidable and MUST be avoided. The pull-shaped design: the caller becomes a MEMBER PUBLISHED DIRECTLY BY THE SCC PRODUCER (mirroring settle_demand_cone's external/member split, runtime_demand.rs:286-323). In-cone members get ZERO scheduler wakes (N -> 0); they wake only on genuinely-external cone settlement via changed-revision. No job pushes the caller. This STRENGTHENS the follow_up-elimination arc, does not violate it. VERIFIED: settle_demand_cone (the model) is genuinely pull — the whole Kleene ascent runs inside one Rust call, pull.rs never calls agenda.enqueue, re-settle only on epoch/changed-revision.

OBSTACLE (honest sizing): AnalyzeActivation is an ordinary Job publishing MANY heterogeneous facts (ActivationAnalyzed/ReturnType/CallSiteTargets/CallSiteSummary/Activation/Executable, semantic.rs:184-256), with clause-walk intertwined with World mutation and the load-bearing non-blocking-read invariant. Converting it to a cone-settling producer is comparable in size to the ENTIRE fz-go4.18.22 arc applied to the semantic layer. Feasible in principle; a dedicated multi-step arc, not a quick round.

DIRECTION (b) — per-callsite granular re-derive: REJECTED as primary. analyze_activation (semantic.rs:66-262) is monolithic: return_evidence folds via join across every reachable clause (:170), value_types accumulates across the whole body, CallSiteSummary emitted only after the full walk. A single callee bump can change the join over every clause, so per-callsite isolation needs surgery. Decisively, (b) changes WORK-PER-WAKE, not WAKE-COUNT — it would still fire N times (wrong cost axis; the churn is wake count, and changed=false re-walks of small bodies are already cheap). It stays pull-mechanically but cannot be the primary fix.

6-STEP PLAN (for the dedicated arc): (1) SCC membership from stable CallSiteTargets; (2) parallel Kleene ascent reusing apply_steps/analyze_entry as PURE helpers (no World mutation mid-ascent); (3) publish-once at fixpoint (all members' heterogeneous facts batched, like settle_demand_cone memoizes all members); (4) non-recursive case = 1-member no-op (must not regress the common path); (5) prove via telemetry + the landed return_type.defined.changed field (target: root-fn re-fires drop from ~22 to ~= distinct-input count; identical re-publications ~0); (6) update semantic-fixpoint.md + fact-engine.md.

MEASURED BASELINE (HEAD dc26bf0b0, --log-telemetry, using the new changed field): 00001 quicksort — AnalyzeActivation 72 spans, 23 root-fn fires, return_type 1 changed / 22 unchanged, callsite.defined 136 total (59 changed / 77 unchanged). 00181 enum-reduce — AnalyzeActivation 45 spans, 5 root-fn fires, return_type 1 changed / 4 unchanged, callsite.defined 34 (21/13). Acceptance for the arc: identical callsite/return_type re-publications ~0; AnalyzeActivation root-fn fires ~= distinct input revisions (near 12 on 00001, not 22); suite green; minimal-job-trace gate; products byte-identical.

SEQUENCING: schedule as a dedicated arc AFTER any in-flight semantic.rs work; it is the natural continuation of the fz-go4.18.22 (RuntimeDemand SCC-settle) + fz-go4.18.24 (follow_up-elimination) line — the same cone-internal-producer shape applied to analysis.
